programme.desc: While Vibhuti and Tiwari's vacation plans backfire due to blackmail, Anita and Angoori retrieve the video from Pammi, yet they confront their husbands as Happu arrests the blackmailer.

programme.title: Bhabi ji Ghar Par Hai!
programme.desc: Vibhuti expresses his criticism towards a magazine article read by Anita. Later, Manmohan interrupts them after seeing them kiss each other.

programme.title: Bhabi ji Ghar Par Hai!
programme.desc: Vibhuti delivers an electrical jolt to Saxena during their encounter. Later, when Angoori's home loses power, Vibhuti employs his abilities to operate her kitchen appliance.

programme.title: Bhabi ji Ghar Par Hai!
programme.desc: Manmohan comes to Anita and touches her. But this leads to an electric shock spreading throughout Anita's body. She tells him to go away.

programme.title: Bhabi ji Ghar Par Hai!
programme.desc: Anita bans gambling, but Manmohan lures a jobless Vibhuti into Saxena's game with money.

programme.title: Bhabi ji Ghar Par Hai!
programme.desc: Vibhuti participates in a high-stakes game with Tiwari and their acquaintances. Subsequently, Vibhuti wagers his freedom, loses the match, and enters domestic servitude.
